Installed CLI evidence (codex-cli 0.149.0), sanitized and transcribed from
`codex app-server --help` and `codex app-server proxy --help`:

  proxy  Proxy stdio bytes to the running app-server control socket

Usage: codex app-server proxy [OPTIONS]

Options:
  --sock <SOCKET_PATH>  Path to the app-server Unix domain socket to connect to
  -h, --help            Print help

The command is visible in installed CLI help. The capture attempt used the
default endpoint and reported that no control socket existed. The endpoint path
and the CLI's unrelated configuration override help text are intentionally not
retained.
